WITH published_products AS (
    SELECT id FROM products WHERE status = ?
), eligible_variants AS (
    SELECT p.id AS product_id, v.id AS variant_id, v.selling_price AS display_amount
    FROM published_products p
    JOIN product_variants v ON v.product_id = p.id
    UNION ALL
    SELECT p.id, CAST(NULL AS uuid), CAST(NULL AS numeric)
    FROM published_products p
    WHERE ? = true
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variants v WHERE v.product_id = p.id)
), eligible_products AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (product_id) product_id, variant_id, display_amount
    FROM eligible_variants
    ORDER BY product_id ASC, display_amount ASC NULLS LAST, variant_id ASC NULLS LAST
), totals AS (
    SELECT count(*) AS total_elements FROM eligible_products
), candidate_page AS (
    SELECT product_id, variant_id, display_amount
    FROM eligible_products
    ORDER BY product_id ASC
    LIMIT ? OFFSET ?
)
SELECT p.product_id, p.variant_id, p.display_amount, t.total_elements
FROM totals t
LEFT JOIN candidate_page p ON true
ORDER BY p.product_id ASC NULLS LAST
